title: What the Stars Are Made Of
subtitle: 宇宙奥秘 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 宇宙奥秘（宇宙探索·宇宙与起源）
meta: 主题语境：宇宙奥秘（宇宙探索·宇宙与起源）　|　核心词汇：matter　|　正文 389 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 matter 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: When I was small I thought the universe was mostly light. Then our science teacher told us that everything we can touch — the ground under our feet, the air around us, the water in a cup — is ① matter, while all the stars put together make up less than five per cent of it. The rest is a kind of ② matter that nobody has ever seen or weighed, though we can measure its pull on everything else.

That question would not leave me alone. Nobody in my class cared, and that hardly ③ mattered either. Our school observatory was cold and its telescope was thirty years old, so most nights there was nothing worth seeing. It did not ④ matter to me. I copied the readings anyway, kept them in a notebook, and after two winters I had the path of one faint comet that nobody had followed for years. The amount of data was tiny, but for a sixteen-year-old it was no small ⑤ matter.

My adviser read the notebook twice before she spoke. 'This is a ⑥ matter of patience rather than talent,' she said. 'Every number you write down has to be checked twice.' ⑦ As a matter of fact, she checked my first table four times herself, and each time she found a line that someone else would have missed.

She never made me feel small about those lines. ⑧ No matter how many times we started again from the beginning, she stayed patient, and in returning to the same columns I slowly formed the habit of checking my own work. To most people a faint comet hardly matters, and yet I had worked on nothing else for two winters.

One clear night in March the camera stopped working in the middle of a long exposure. 'What's the ⑨ matter?' she asked when she came in. I told her the machine was cold and tired, like the rest of us. Last spring the comet returned exactly where my table said it would, and the small room was full of people. My adviser had drafted the report herself; ⑩ for that matter, half the teachers in the building came up those stairs. A reporter asked me whether such distant work really matters to ordinary lives. I said that every person standing there was made of the same matter that makes the stars burn.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 物质（与精神、能量相对）
C. n. 毛病；麻烦事（多用于 What's the matter?）
E. 固定搭配：a matter of ……的问题
F. 固定搭配：as a matter of fact 事实上
G. 固定搭配：no matter what/how/who 无论
H. 固定搭配：for that matter 而且，说到这一点

items.q: the water in a cup — is matter
a kind of matter that nobody has ever seen
It did not matter to me
This is a matter of patience
As a matter of fact, she checked my first table
No matter how many times we started again
for that matter, half the teachers

answers.why: 与 everything we can touch、the ground / the air / the water 并列，且下句说星星加起来不足百分之五，指构成宇宙的“物质”。
a kind of matter that nobody has ever seen or weighed 指看不见也称不出的那类物质（暗物质），仍是名词“物质”。
that hardly mattered either 意为“那也不怎么要紧”，主语是事，matter 作动词用。
It did not matter to me＝“对我来说无所谓”，是动词“要紧；有关系”的典型句式。
no small matter 是固定说法，意为“绝不是小事”，此处 matter 是名词“事情”。
a matter of patience rather than talent 意为“是耐心的问题而不是天赋的问题”，取固定搭配“……的问题”。
as a matter of fact 位于句首作插入语，意为“事实上”，后面紧接着讲她真的检查了四遍。
no matter how many times＋让步从句，意为“无论多少次”，后接主句 she stayed patient。
What's the matter? 是询问“出了什么毛病／怎么了”，此处询问相机出了什么故障。
for that matter 意为“而且，说到这一点”，表示在已说过的事之外再补充一层，这里补充说连老师都上楼来了。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我们触摸得到的一切 —— 水、空气和泥土 —— 都是物质。（matter n.）
对一名十六岁的学生来说，那绝不是一件小事。（no small matter）
这不过是耐心的问题，不是天赋的问题。（a matter of）
事实上，她把我的第一张表格检查了四遍。（as a matter of fact）
无论我们重新开始多少次，她都很有耐心。（no matter how）
那天夜里相机出了什么毛病？（What's the matter）
answers: Everything we can touch — water, air and soil — is matter.
For a sixteen-year-old student, it was no small matter.
It is simply a matter of patience rather than talent.
As a matter of fact, she checked my first table four times.
No matter how many times we started again, she stayed patient.
What was the matter with the camera that night?

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 matter 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Looking through the old telescope that night, I understood why the universe is made mostly of matter we cannot see.
The amount of data we collected was tiny, but the habit of checking every number was no small matter.
My adviser said that research is a matter of patience rather than talent.
As a matter of fact, she checked my first table four times herself.
No matter how cold the observatory was, we went back every clear night to measure the faint comet.
For that matter, half our class now knows that everything we touch was once inside a star.
